description: Literal cleanup: remove all hardcoded demo defaults from API routes, seed data, worker services, and the dashboard. Covers Items 13-15 of the phase3-partB plan. This FEAT is fully independent of FEAT-001 — it touches different files and has no runtime dependency on the new activity or factory. It can be applied in any order relative to FEAT-001.
steps: Step 1 — api/src/routes/agent_config.py: In test_agent_with_dynamic_data, brand_liability branch (~line 221), change 'fiscal_year = sample.get("fiscal_year", "FY2026-27")' to 'fiscal_year = sample.get("fiscal_year", "")' and add: 'if not fiscal_year: raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="fiscal_year is required in sample_input for brand_liability test")'. Also change 'historic_debt = agent_cfg.parameters.get("historical_debt_default_tons", 3600.0)' to 'historic_debt = agent_cfg.parameters.get("historical_debt_default_tons")' and add: 'if historic_debt is None: raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="historical_debt_default_tons not configured for this agent")'.
Step 2 — api/src/routes/organizations.py: In the preview_data_source endpoint's else-branch (~line 412), change 'fiscal_year="FY2026-27"' to 'fiscal_year=""' in the connector.query_sales_data call.

Step 3 — api/src/routes/liability.py: Two changes. In trigger_liability_calculation (~line 19) change 'fiscal_year = payload.get("fiscal_year", "FY2026-27")' to 'fiscal_year = payload.get("fiscal_year", "")'. In get_liability_report query param (~line 33) change 'fiscal_year: str = "FY2026-27"' to 'fiscal_year: str = ""'.

Step 4 — packages/synthetiq-shared/synthetiq_shared/seed.py: In DEFAULT_AGENTS_CONFIG, find the brand_liability dict's 'parameters' subdictionary and remove exactly two keys: 'target_fiscal_year': 'FY2026-27' and 'historical_debt_default_tons': 3600.0. Then find the regulatory_watchdog dict's 'parameters' subdictionary and remove exactly one key: 'statutory_base_rate_inr': 12.0. All other keys in these dicts must remain unchanged.

Step 5 — worker/src/services/ai_service.py: Inside the extract_regulatory_rules method's LLM prompt JSON template (~line 193), change '"fiscal_year": "FY2026-27"' to '"fiscal_year": ""'. This is inside a Python string/f-string; only the value changes, not the surrounding template structure.
Step 6 — worker/src/services/scheduler_service.py: In _trigger_workflow's payload dict (~line 295), change 'params.get("fiscal_year", "FY2026-27")' to 'params.get("fiscal_year", "")'.

Step 7 — dashboard/app/agents/page.tsx: Before editing, check node_modules/next/dist/docs/ from the dashboard directory for any breaking API changes in this version of Next.js (required by the dashboard AGENTS.md rule). Locate line ~107: '{config?.gemini?.model || "Gemini 3.8 Flash"}'. Change to '{config?.gemini?.model || "\u2014"}' (em-dash U+2014). The surrounding JSX structure must not change.
acceptance_criteria: Get-ChildItem api/src,packages/synthetiq-shared/synthetiq_shared -Recurse -Include '*.py' | Select-String -Pattern '"FY2026-27"|historical_debt_default_tons.*3600|target_fiscal_year|"statutory_base_rate_inr".*12' | Where-Object { $_.Line -notmatch '#' } returns zero matches
Get-ChildItem worker/src -Recurse -Include '*.py' | Select-String -Pattern '"FY2026-27"' | Where-Object { $_.Line -notmatch '#' } returns zero matches
cd dashboard && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | Select-String 'agents/page' returns no TypeScript errors
The string 'Gemini 3.8 Flash' no longer appears anywhere in dashboard/app/agents/page.tsx
findings: All 7 steps implemented. ai_service.py method is named analyze_regulatory_rules (not extract_regulatory_rules as in plan) — change applied to correct method at line 193. ai_service smoke import fails due to missing google.generativeai in shell env (pre-existing, unrelated to change). scheduler_service imports clean. All 3 verification grep commands return zero matches. TSX tsc check passes with no agents/page errors.
